records.name: Conjunction
records.description: Planets in the same place. Energy is amplified and blended.

records.name: Opposition
records.description: Planets are opposite each other. Represents polarity, tension, and awareness.

records.name: Trine
records.description: Planets are 120 degrees apart. Represents ease, flow, and natural talent.

records.name: Square
records.description: Planets are 90 degrees apart. Represents internal conflict, tension, and drive for action.

records.name: Sextile
records.description: Planets are 60 degrees apart. Represents opportunity, talent, and friendship that requires effort.

records.name: Quincunx
records.description: Also called Inconjunct. Represents irritation, adjustment, and blind spots.

records.name: Semi-sextile
records.description: Planets are 30 degrees apart. Represents subtle growth and mild friction.

records.name: Semi-square
records.description: Planets are 45 degrees apart. Represents internal friction and agitation.

records.name: Sesquiquadrate
records.description: Planets are 135 degrees apart. Represents external challenges and need for adjustment.

records.name: Quintile
records.description: Planets are 72 degrees apart. Associated with creative talent and dynamic energy.

records.name: Biquintile
records.description: Planets are 144 degrees apart. Associated with mastery, creative will, and arranging things.
